generate_text_translation: generate text translations using SeamlessM4Tv2ForTextToText with target language specified
generate_speech_transcription: generate speech-to-text transcriptions using SeamlessM4Tv2ForSpeechToText from audio input features

generate_speech_translation: generate speech-to-speech translation using SeamlessM4Tv2ForSpeechToSpeech from audio input with target language
